# Results (generated by examples/run_demo.py; seeds fixed)

1000 daily observations, 100 repetitions, zero true skill.

| 1 | 0.11 | 0.00 |
| 2 | 0.30 | 0.22 |
| 5 | 0.57 | 0.55 |
| 10 | 0.80 | 0.79 |
| 25 | 0.97 | 0.98 |
| 50 | 1.11 | 1.13 |
| 100 | 1.28 | 1.28 |
| 270 | 1.42 | 1.44 |
| 500 | 1.52 | 1.53 |

## 2. Deflated Sharpe ratio, best of 270 skill-free strategies (one illustrative run, seed 7)

Best annualised Sharpe 1.36; luck alone is expected to produce 1.50.
Naive PSR, the probability that the true Sharpe exceeds zero: 0.996. Deflated Sharpe ratio, the probability it exceeds the luck benchmark for 270 trials: 0.393.

## 3. Probability of backtest overfitting (one illustrative run: 60 strategies, 1,600 days, 16 blocks)

Sharpe ratios are annualised and averaged over the 12,870 splits.

| Scenario | PBO | In-sample Sharpe of winner | Out-of-sample Sharpe of winner | P(loss out-of-sample) |
|---|---:|---:|---:|---:|
| No skill anywhere | 0.52 | 1.22 | -0.10 | 0.54 |
| One real edge (annual Sharpe 1.0) | 0.33 | 1.40 | 0.34 | 0.34 |
| One real edge (annual Sharpe 2.0) | 0.02 | 2.18 | 2.12 | 0.02 |

## 4. Circular-shift placebo (one illustrative run)

| Signal | Observed annual Sharpe | p-value |
|---|---:|---:|
| Signal with a real link to returns | 2.71 | 0.002 |
| Equally persistent but unrelated signal | -0.17 | 0.789 |

## 5. Look-ahead bug

Six random-walk universes of 20,000 bars each. The biased version keeps only winning bars, so every trade is profitable by construction and its t-statistics mean nothing.

| Version | Avg return per trade (bps) | Avg trades | t-statistics (six universes) |
|---|---:|---:|---|
| Select on close, fill at level (biased) | 58.6 | 5,797 | not meaningful |
| Honest stop-order fill | 0.60 | 10,066 | 1.0, 0.5, -0.1, -0.0, 2.4, 0.7 |

## 6. Do the defenses work in general? Repeated experiments

| Experiment | Result |
|---|---|
| Best of 270 skill-free strategies, 200 universes: share the naive PSR calls significant (>0.95) | 100.0% |
| Same universes: share the Deflated Sharpe Ratio calls significant (>0.95) | 0.0% |
| Power: one strategy among 270 has a real annual Sharpe of 2.0 / 3.0; share DSR > 0.95, 100 universes each | 24% / 92% |
| PBO with no skill anywhere, 12 universes: mean (min to max) | 0.51 (0.29 to 0.85) |
| Placebo test on 200 persistent signals unrelated to returns: share with p < 0.05 | 4.0% |
